title: Romance-baiting scam: AI-assisted pig butchering workflows
summary: OpenAI banned accounts that appeared to originate in Cambodia and used AI to translate and generate romance, investment scam conversations.
body: OpenAI banned accounts that appeared to originate in Cambodia and used AI to translate and generate romance, investment scam conversations.
summaryZh: OpenAI官方披露并封禁了一批源自柬埔寨等地区的违规账户。这些账户利用大模型进行自动化翻译与生成，开展浪漫诈骗和“杀猪盘”投资欺诈工作流。这表明生成式AI正被黑产用于规模化、多语言的欺诈活动，促使模型厂商强化滥用监控。

aiReview.reasonZh: OpenAI打击利用大模型进行跨国浪漫和投资诈骗的自动化工作流，对行业安全防御有重要参考价值。
